# vergeio_certificate (Resource)

`vergeio_certificate` is a TLS certificate for the VergeOS UI and API. `type` is `manual`, `letsencrypt`, or `self_signed`. Changing `type` replaces the certificate. Changing a configured `domain_name` replaces it too. Leaving `domain_name` out keeps the name already stored.

A manual certificate needs `public_certificate` and `private_key_wo`. `private_key_wo` is sent when the certificate is created and when `private_key_wo_version` changes. Terraform stores the version, not the private key.

An ACME certificate (`letsencrypt`) needs `domain_name` or `domain_list`, `contact` set to the user id whose email is the account contact, and `agree_tos` set to true. `eab_hmac_key_wo` is the external account binding secret for a private ACME server. Terraform stores `eab_hmac_key_wo_version`, not that secret.

A `self_signed` certificate is generated by VergeOS from `domain_name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A certificate VergeOS generates for the UI.
# Changing type replaces the certificate. Changing this domain_name replaces it too.

resource "vergeio_certificate" "example" {
  type        = "self_signed"
  domain_name = "ui.example.com"
  key_type    = "ecdsa"
  description = "UI certificate"
}
```

Upload a certificate you already have. `private_key_wo` is not stored.

```terraform
# private_key_wo is sent on create and when private_key_wo_version changes.
# Terraform stores the version, not the private key.

resource "vergeio_certificate" "uploaded" {
  type        = "manual"
  domain_name = "ui.example.com"
  description = "Uploaded UI certificate"

  public_certificate = <<-EOT
  -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
  MIIB
  -----END CERTIFICATE-----
  EOT

  private_key_wo = <<-EOT
  -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
  MIIB
  -----END PRIVATE KEY-----
  EOT

  private_key_wo_version = 1
}
```

Request a certificate from Let's Encrypt. `contact` is a VergeOS user id.

```terraform
# contact is the user id whose email Let's Encrypt uses.
# agree_tos must be true.

resource "vergeio_certificate" "acme" {
  type        = "letsencrypt"
  domain_name = "ui.example.com"
  domain_list = "ui.example.com,api.example.com"
  contact     = 1
  agree_tos   = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Certificate type: manual, letsencrypt, or self_signed. Changing it replaces the certificate.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `acme_server` (String) ACME directory URL. Leave unset to use Let's Encrypt. Omit to leave the current server unchanged.
- `agree_tos` (Boolean) Agree to the ACME provider terms of service. Required and must be true for type letsencrypt.
- `chain` (String) Certificate chain in PEM form. Omit to leave the current chain unchanged.
- `contact` (Number) User id whose email is the ACME contact. Required for type letsencrypt.
- `description` (String) What this certificate is for. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `domain_list` (String) Comma separated subject alternative names. Omit to leave the current list unchanged.
- `domain_name` (String) Primary domain. Required for self_signed. A manual certificate can omit it. A letsencrypt certificate can set domain_list instead. Changing a configured value replaces the certificate. Omitting it leaves the current name in place. After import, a self_signed certificate uses domainname from that certificate row. A manual certificate uses domain when VergeOS reports one.
- `eab_hmac_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) External account binding HMAC key. Sent when the certificate is created and when eab_hmac_key_wo_version changes. Terraform does not store it. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11.
- `eab_hmac_key_wo_version` (Number) Version of eab_hmac_key_wo. Increment it to send a new HMAC key. Terraform stores this number, not the key.
- `eab_kid` (String) External account binding key identifier for a private ACME server. VergeOS does not return this on the standard certificate read, so Terraform keeps the configured value.
- `key_type` (String) Key algorithm for a generated certificate: ecdsa or rsa. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Private key in PEM form. Required for type manual. Sent when the certificate is created and when private_key_wo_version changes. Terraform does not store it. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11.
- `private_key_wo_version` (Number) Version of private_key_wo. Increment it to send a new private key. Terraform stores this number, not the key.
- `public_certificate` (String) Public certificate in PEM form. Required for type manual. VergeOS returns this text on read.
- `rsa_key_size` (String) RSA key size, such as 2048. Used when key_type is rsa. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

### Read-Only

- `autocreated` (Boolean) Whether VergeOS created this certificate on its own.
- `created` (Number) Time the certificate was created, as seconds since the epoch.
- `domain` (String) Primary domain reported by VergeOS.
- `expires` (Number) Expiration time, as seconds since the epoch.
- `id` (String) Certificate key assigned by VergeOS.
- `modified` (Number) Time the certificate was last modified, as seconds since the epoch.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether VergeOS considers the certificate valid.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The `terraform import` command can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vergeio_certificate.example <certificate_key>
```
